title: The Harbor of Vilna
author: Astrid Yarrow
blurb: Isandro Okonkwo, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
